column7: Jesus is not **just** sent from God; He **is** part of God. Jesus abides in the Father and the Father abides in Jesus. The Gospel of John repeatedly establishes that Jesus and the Father are one (John 10:30), that Jesus did not act on His own accord (John 5:19; John 12:49-50), and that everything He did was to glorify His Father (John 17:4; John 14:13), and was done by the authority and power of His Father (John 14:10; John 8:28-29).
